title: Vapor Deluxe Daddy Filling Chambers
description:
Enhance your vaping experience with the Vapor Deluxe Daddy Filling Chambers. Specifically designed for the Daddy Deluxe Vaporizer, these chambers ensure optimal heat distribution for a smooth vapor release.

The set includes the TV-W112 regular filling chamber paired with the TV-W114 wand piece, offering everything you need minus the tube and mouthpiece. With rave reviews from satisfied customers, it’s evident that these filling chambers are a must-have for every vapor enthusiast.

Plus, with the ELEV8 FATTY WHIP and TV-W11 SCREEN PACKS now in stock, you’re all set for a top-notch vaping session. Upgrade your vaporizer parts and feel the difference!
